integrity: The source formulas for the unit-weight de Jonquieres map, weight-independent symmetric pullback matrix, limiting ray, and balanced reflection were independently combined with an exact intersection computation for the weight-q orbit curve. The rationality condition reduces symbolically to a factored determinant, and the packaged verifier replays that algebra exactly.
scientific_limitations: This is a template obstruction: it assumes the same one-orbit weight-q dihedral geometry, the same uniform de Jonquieres action on the symmetric marked subspace, and reflection in the orbit curve. It does not rule out a different finite group, a different reflection curve, different dynamics, or an even-n irrational limiting ray by another method.
title: A unit-weight obstruction for even dihedral Seshadri constructions
